senses.en: To give a loud, high cry from strong emotion.
A loud, high cry expressing fear, pain, or excitement.

ex.en: The children screamed with excitement as the ride began.
Residents complain that visitors scream late at night, disturbing sleep and reducing the neighbourhood's quality of life.

col: scream with excitement｜hét lên vì phấn khích
scream for help｜kêu cứu thất thanh
let out a scream｜thốt lên một tiếng hét
tip: scream nhấn mạnh tiếng thét the thé; shout chỉ nhấn mạnh việc nói to.

senses.en: Having great physical strength or producing a strong effect.

senses.zh: có quyền lực; có ảnh hưởng lớn
senses.en: Able to control people or strongly influence events.

ex.en: The powerful wind blew our garden chairs onto the grass.
Powerful companies should take greater responsibility for reducing the environmental damage caused by their operations.

col: powerful argument｜lập luận có sức thuyết phục
tip: Thường là tính từ; trạng từ là powerfully, không dùng powerful.

senses.en: Literature using carefully arranged language, rhythm, and imagery.

senses.zh: chất thơ; vẻ đẹp như thơ
senses.en: Beauty or emotional power resembling that of poems.

ex.en: She reads poetry aloud while her tea cools.
Studying poetry encourages students to explore complex emotions and appreciate the expressive possibilities of language.

tip: poetry không đếm được; một bài thơ là a poem, không dùng a poetry.

senses.en: Showing poor judgement or a lack of good sense.

ex.en: It was foolish to leave my umbrella at home.
It would be foolish to expand road networks without considering their long-term effects on air quality.

col: a foolish mistake｜một sai lầm ngớ ngẩn
foolish to assume｜thật dại dột khi cho rằng
tip: Thường dùng It is foolish to do để nói làm điều gì là không khôn ngoan.

senses.en: Find the size, amount, or degree of something.
An action intended to achieve a particular result.

senses.zh: thước đo; tiêu chuẩn đánh giá
senses.en: A way of judging the quality or degree of something.

ex.en: We measured the window before buying new curtains.
Governments should introduce effective measures to reduce air pollution without placing excessive costs on low-income households.

col: take measures to do something｜thực hiện các biện pháp để làm việc gì
a measure of success｜thước đo của thành công
tip: Thực hiện biện pháp dùng take measures; đo cái gì thì đi thẳng với tân ngữ.

senses.en: A shaped frame used to hang clothes.

ex.en: She put her jacket on a wooden hanger.
Retailers can reduce plastic waste by collecting used hangers and replacing damaged ones with recyclable alternatives.

col: wire hanger｜móc áo bằng dây thép
tip: hanger là móc áo; hangar là nhà chứa máy bay, chú ý chính tả.

senses.zh: đá quý; đồ trang sức đá quý
senses.en: A valuable stone, often used in decorative personal objects.
Someone or something especially valuable, beautiful, or admired.

ex.en: A blue jewel sparkled on her silver necklace.
The restored theatre is a cultural jewel that attracts visitors and supports local businesses.

col: a jewel in the crown｜viên ngọc quý nhất; thành tựu đáng giá nhất
tip: jewel là danh từ đếm được; jewellery là từ chung chỉ trang sức, không đếm được.

senses.en: A picture or visual representation of someone or something.
The impression that people have of a person or organization.
A picture of someone or something formed in your mind.

ex.en: The camera captured a sharp image of the bird.
Companies increasingly use social media to improve their public image and build stronger relationships with customers.

col: digital image｜hình ảnh kỹ thuật số
public image｜hình ảnh trước công chúng
high-resolution image｜hình ảnh độ phân giải cao
tip: Có thể chỉ hình ảnh cụ thể, hoặc hình ảnh công chúng của một người hay tổ chức.

senses.en: an imaginary creature that is large, strange, or frightening
a person who behaves in an extremely cruel way
extremely large in size or amount

ex.en: The friendly monster in the cartoon has purple feet.
Stories about monsters can help children explore their fears within a safe and imaginative setting.

col: a monster truck｜xe tải bánh khổng lồ
a fictional monster｜quái vật hư cấu
tip: Nghĩa tính từ khá khẩu ngữ, đặt trước danh từ để chỉ cái rất lớn.

senses.en: A result or level that someone aims to achieve.

senses.zh: bia; đối tượng bị nhắm tới
senses.en: A person or thing aimed at or attacked.
To direct actions or attention towards a particular person or group.

ex.en: My savings target is enough for a new bicycle.
Governments should set realistic targets for reducing emissions and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.

col: target vulnerable groups｜nhắm vào nhóm dễ bị tổn thương
tip: Để nói đạt mục tiêu, dùng meet hoặc reach a target.

senses.en: Able to speak or write a language easily and smoothly.

ex.en: She became fluent in Spanish after living abroad.
Fluent speakers may still make grammatical mistakes, so language assessments should consider both communication skills and accuracy.

col: fluent in English｜thành thạo tiếng Anh
a fluent speaker｜người nói lưu loát
tip: Nói thành thạo một ngôn ngữ dùng be fluent in; lưu loát không có nghĩa là không mắc lỗi.

senses.en: Move against a surface with pressure, often repeatedly.
An act of pressing and moving against a surface.

ex.en: She rubbed her cold hands together beside the heater.
Protective gloves prevent workers from rubbing their skin against rough surfaces when handling heavy materials.

col: rub your hands together｜xoa hai tay vào nhau
give something a rub｜chà lau qua cái gì
tip: Quá khứ rubbed và hiện tại phân từ rubbing đều gấp đôi chữ b.

senses.en: A coastal tower with a powerful light that guides ships.

ex.en: The lighthouse beam swept across the dark sea.
Although modern navigation relies on satellites, lighthouses remain valuable landmarks along dangerous stretches of coastline.

col: historic lighthouse｜ngọn hải đăng lịch sử
tip: Danh từ đếm được, số nhiều chỉ cần thêm s: lighthouses.

senses.zh: câu trả lời; sự đáp lại
senses.en: Something said or written as an answer.
An action or change caused by an event or situation.

ex.en: I sent an invitation but haven't received a response yet.
A rapid response to disease outbreaks can protect vulnerable communities and reduce pressure on local hospitals.

col: a response to｜phản hồi đối với
receive a response｜nhận được phản hồi
tip: response thường theo sau là to, không dùng of.

senses.en: Relating to the sun.
Using energy from sunlight to produce heat or electricity.

ex.en: We wore special protective glasses to watch the solar eclipse.
Investment in solar energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and create jobs in rural communities.

tip: solar là tính từ, thường dùng trong các cụm liên quan đến mặt trời hoặc năng lượng mặt trời.

senses.zh: quyền sử dụng; cơ hội tiếp cận
senses.en: The opportunity or right to enter or use something.
A way of reaching or entering a place.
Reach, enter, or obtain something, especially information on a computer.

ex.en: Guests have access to the pool until sunset.
Affordable internet access enables rural students to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.

col: access to education｜được tiếp cận giáo dục
gain access to｜có được quyền sử dụng hoặc quyền vào
tip: Danh từ đi với to; động từ đi thẳng với tân ngữ, không thêm to.

senses.en: different from someone or something

senses.zh: không giống như thường lệ của ai
senses.en: not typical of someone's usual behaviour

ex.en: Unlike her brother, Lina enjoys getting up early.
Unlike private cars, public transport can move large groups of people while using relatively little road space.

col: unlike most people｜không giống hầu hết mọi người
unlike anything else｜không giống bất cứ thứ gì khác
it's unlike someone to｜làm việc gì không giống tính cách của ai
tip: unlike theo sau là danh từ hoặc đại từ; không nối trực tiếp với một câu hoàn chỉnh.

senses.zh: cuộc tranh cãi; sự cãi vã
senses.en: An angry disagreement between people.
A reason or set of reasons supporting an opinion.

ex.en: We had an argument about whose turn it was.
The strongest argument for public transport investment is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.

col: a convincing argument｜một lập luận thuyết phục
an argument for｜lý lẽ ủng hộ
an argument against｜lý lẽ phản đối
tip: Cãi nhau thường đi với with hoặc about; lý lẽ ủng hộ một quan điểm dùng argument for.

senses.en: feeling guilty or embarrassed about something wrong or disappointing
unwilling to do something because it feels embarrassing

ex.en: I felt ashamed after laughing at my friend's mistake.
Students should never feel ashamed to ask for help when they struggle with difficult subjects.

col: ashamed of yourself｜xấu hổ về bản thân
ashamed to admit｜ngượng khi phải thừa nhận
tip: Thường làm vị ngữ: be ashamed of hoặc be ashamed to do.

senses.en: Money received regularly from work, investments, or other sources.

ex.en: My weekend job gives me a small extra income.
Affordable public transport allows families on low incomes to access employment and essential services more easily.

col: household income｜thu nhập hộ gia đình
tip: income rộng hơn salary, còn gồm tiền cho thuê và lợi nhuận đầu tư.

senses.en: outside a building, in the open air
the natural world away from buildings

ex.en: The weather is warm enough to eat outdoors tonight.
Spending time outdoors can improve children's wellbeing and encourage greater interest in protecting the natural environment.

col: spend time outdoors｜dành thời gian ngoài trời
the great outdoors｜thiên nhiên rộng lớn
tip: outdoors là trạng từ; để bổ nghĩa cho danh từ dùng outdoor, như outdoor activities.

senses.en: Something helpful you do for someone.

senses.zh: sự ủng hộ; sự ưu ái
senses.en: Approval, support, or preference shown towards someone or something.

senses.zh: ưa chuộng; ủng hộ; có lợi cho
senses.en: To prefer, support, or give an advantage to someone or something.

ex.en: Could you do me a favour and water my plants?
Many residents favour investment in public transport because it can reduce congestion and improve air quality.

col: do someone a favour｜giúp ai một việc
in favour of｜ủng hộ; tán thành
return the favour｜đáp lại ơn huệ
favour one option over another｜ưu tiên lựa chọn này hơn lựa chọn khác
tip: Anh Anh viết favour, Anh Mỹ viết favor; “giúp ai một việc” dùng do someone a favour.

senses.en: a frightening or deeply unpleasant dream
an experience or situation that is extremely unpleasant or difficult

ex.en: I woke from a nightmare and switched on the lamp.
Without reliable public transport, commuting can become a nightmare for people living outside major cities.

col: recurring nightmare｜cơn ác mộng lặp đi lặp lại
logistical nightmare｜một bài toán hậu cần hóc búa
tip: Thường là danh từ đếm được; tính từ là nightmarish.

senses.zh: đồ lót; quần áo mặc sát người
senses.en: Clothes worn next to the skin beneath other clothes.

ex.en: I packed clean underwear in my travel bag.
Consumers increasingly prefer underwear made from breathable fabrics, encouraging manufacturers to improve comfort and durability.

col: a change of underwear｜một bộ đồ lót để thay
tip: Danh từ không đếm được, không nói an underwear hay underwears.

senses.en: A line of people or vehicles waiting for something.
To wait in a line for your turn.

ex.en: We joined the queue outside the bakery this morning.
Improved ticketing systems can reduce the time passengers spend waiting in a queue at busy stations.

col: queue for tickets｜xếp hàng mua vé
a long queue｜hàng dài người chờ
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh thường dùng queue, tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng line; queue for theo sau là thứ đang chờ.

senses.en: a small, usually round fruit, often growing in clusters

ex.en: She dropped a ripe berry into her bowl of yoghurt.
Protecting native shrubs ensures that birds have access to berries and other food sources throughout the year.

tip: Số nhiều là berries; cách dùng thường ngày khác với định nghĩa thực vật học.

senses.en: A small device that produces a flame to light things.

ex.en: Dad used a long lighter to light the candle.
A refillable lighter may produce less plastic waste than disposable alternatives when used over a long period.

col: a refillable lighter｜bật lửa có thể nạp lại
a disposable lighter｜bật lửa dùng một lần
tip: Làm danh từ nghĩa là bật lửa; cũng là dạng so sánh hơn của light, nghĩa là “nhẹ hơn”.

senses.en: a woody part growing from a tree's trunk
a local office or division of a larger organization or subject
to divide into separate routes or parts

ex.en: A small bird landed on the lowest branch.
Opening a local branch allows banks to provide essential services to communities with limited internet access.

col: a branch of science｜một ngành của khoa học
tip: branch vừa là cành cây, vừa là chi nhánh của tổ chức hoặc một nhánh của lĩnh vực.

senses.en: A structure animals build to hold eggs or raise their young.
Build or occupy a nest.

ex.en: A small bird carried twigs to its nest.
Protecting trees where rare birds nest is essential for maintaining biodiversity in areas affected by urban development.

tip: nest vừa là danh từ (tổ chim) vừa là động từ (làm tổ).

senses.en: To become smaller or make something smaller in amount.
A reduction in the size, number, or amount of something.

ex.en: Our electricity bills decreased after we replaced the old heater.
Improved public transport could decrease traffic congestion and reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.

col: a decrease in demand｜nhu cầu giảm
tip: Động từ nhấn âm sau; danh từ /ˈdiːkriːs/ nhấn âm đầu.

senses.en: something said or written to express an opinion or observation

senses.zh: bình luận; đưa ra ý kiến
senses.en: to express an opinion or observation about something

ex.en: Her kind comment about my painting made me smile.
Residents should have opportunities to comment on development proposals before local authorities make final decisions.

col: make a comment｜đưa ra nhận xét
comment on something｜nhận xét về điều gì
constructive comments｜những góp ý mang tính xây dựng
tip: Động từ comment theo sau là on rồi đến đối tượng được bình luận, không đi thẳng với tân ngữ.

senses.en: The earth in which plants grow.
To make something dirty.

ex.en: She filled the pot with soil and planted seeds.
Intensive farming can damage soil quality, reducing the land's ability to support crops over time.

col: soil your clothes｜làm bẩn quần áo
tip: Đất nói chung thường không đếm được; các loại đất khác nhau có thể dùng số nhiều soils.

senses.en: the possibility that something harmful or unpleasant will happen
do something despite the possibility of harm or loss

ex.en: Wear sturdy shoes to reduce the risk of slipping.
Governments should assess the risk of flooding before approving new housing developments near rivers.

col: take a risk｜liều; chấp nhận rủi ro
risk doing something｜liều làm việc gì
tip: risk theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ, không dùng to do.

senses.en: Attractive in appearance, especially describing a man.
Large and impressive in amount.

ex.en: My brother looks handsome in his new blue jacket.
Companies investing in renewable energy may earn handsome profits as demand for cleaner alternatives continues to grow.

col: handsome man｜người đàn ông đẹp trai
tip: Thường dùng để khen đàn ông đẹp trai; với lợi nhuận hoặc phần thưởng nghĩa là hậu hĩnh.

senses.zh: lịch trình; kế hoạch thời gian
senses.en: a plan showing when activities or events will happen

senses.zh: sắp xếp thời gian; lên lịch
senses.en: to arrange for something to happen at a particular time

ex.en: My busy schedule leaves little time for cooking during weekdays.
Universities should schedule examinations carefully to give students sufficient time for revision and recovery between assessments.

col: a busy schedule｜lịch trình bận rộn
ahead of schedule｜sớm hơn kế hoạch
schedule a meeting｜sắp xếp một cuộc họp
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh thường đọc đầu là /ʃ/, tiếng Anh Mỹ đọc /sk/; on schedule nghĩa là đúng giờ, đúng kế hoạch.

senses.en: something incorrect in an action, calculation, or judgement
the difference between a measured value and the true value

ex.en: An error in the booking left us without seats.
Researchers should check their calculations carefully, as a minor error can significantly affect the final conclusions.

col: a margin of error｜biên độ sai số
tip: error trang trọng hơn mistake, thường dùng trong kỹ thuật, tính toán hoặc phán đoán.

senses.en: A rubber covering around a wheel that touches the road.

ex.en: We stopped beside the road to change a flat tyre.
Recycling used tyres can reduce landfill waste and provide materials for safer playground surfaces.

tip: tyre là cách viết của Anh Anh, Anh Mỹ viết tire.

senses.en: An extremely tall building with many floors.

ex.en: The skyscraper cast a long shadow across the park.
Building skyscrapers can accommodate growing urban populations, but cities must also invest in reliable public transport.

col: build a skyscraper｜xây nhà chọc trời
glass skyscraper｜tòa nhà chọc trời ốp kính
towering skyscraper｜tòa nhà chọc trời sừng sững
tip: Nhấn mạnh tòa nhà cực cao, mạnh hơn high-rise thông thường.

senses.zh: sự mệt mỏi; sự kiệt sức
senses.en: the feeling of needing rest or sleep

ex.en: After the long walk, tiredness made my legs feel heavy.
Persistent tiredness can reduce students' concentration and may indicate that they are not getting enough sleep.

col: signs of tiredness｜dấu hiệu mệt mỏi
tip: Thường không đếm được; người mệt dùng tired, việc gây mệt dùng tiring.

senses.en: To a very great degree.
In a very bad or unsuccessful way.

ex.en: I'm terribly sorry I spilled juice on your jacket.
Without reliable public transport, elderly residents may feel terribly isolated in remote rural communities.

tip: Thường dùng như từ nhấn mạnh trong khẩu ngữ, không nhất thiết có nghĩa “khủng khiếp”.

senses.en: Someone who supports a person, belief, or movement
Someone who subscribes to another user's social media updates

ex.en: My uncle is a devoted follower of the local team.
Having many followers on social media does not necessarily make someone a reliable source of health advice.

col: a devoted follower｜người ủng hộ trung thành
social media followers｜người theo dõi trên mạng xã hội
gain followers｜thu hút người theo dõi
tip: Chỉ người đi theo hoặc người theo dõi tài khoản, không nhất thiết là người hâm mộ cuồng nhiệt.

senses.en: the act of speaking to God or a god
words spoken to God or a god

ex.en: She closed her eyes and said a quiet prayer.
For many communities, prayer provides comfort during difficult times and strengthens a sense of belonging.

col: a prayer for peace｜lời cầu nguyện cho hòa bình
tip: Khi chỉ hành động cầu nguyện thường không đếm được; một bài kinh thì đếm được.

senses.en: To make something broken or damaged usable again.
To become healthy again after injury or illness.
To improve a damaged relationship or a difficult situation.

ex.en: Grandpa showed me how to mend a torn pocket.
Teaching children to mend their clothes can reduce textile waste and encourage more responsible attitudes towards consumption.

tip: on the mend nghĩa là đang hồi phục hoặc tình hình đang khá lên.

senses.en: the ice-covered continent surrounding the South Pole

ex.en: My cousin photographed penguins during a trip to Antarctica.
Scientists studying Antarctica analyse ancient ice to understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.

col: expedition to Antarctica｜chuyến thám hiểm châu Nam Cực
research in Antarctica｜nghiên cứu ở châu Nam Cực
the coast of Antarctica｜bờ biển châu Nam Cực
tip: Tên châu viết hoa chữ cái đầu, thường không có the đứng trước.

senses.zh: điểm tham quan; điều thu hút
senses.en: A place or feature that people want to visit or experience.
The power to interest someone or draw them towards something.

ex.en: The old castle is the town's most popular attraction.
Although tourism creates jobs, overcrowding at major attractions can damage historic buildings and disrupt local life.

col: tourist attraction｜điểm tham quan du lịch
mutual attraction｜sự hấp dẫn lẫn nhau
tip: Khi chỉ điểm tham quan thì đếm được; khi chỉ sức hút thì thường không đếm được.

senses.en: an adult male animal of the cattle family

senses.zh: nhà đầu tư kỳ vọng giá tăng
senses.en: an investor who expects market prices to rise

ex.en: A large bull stood quietly beside the farm gate.
During a bull market, rising share prices may encourage households to invest more of their savings.

col: a bull market｜thị trường giá lên
take the bull by the horns｜đương đầu với khó khăn một cách dũng cảm
tip: Trong tài chính, bull là người kỳ vọng giá tăng, trái nghĩa với bear (người kỳ vọng giá giảm).

senses.en: to put something in the ground and cover it
to hide or cover something beneath other things

ex.en: Our dog buried its favourite toy beside the fence.
Instead of burying household waste, local authorities should invest in recycling facilities and public education.

col: be buried under｜bị chôn vùi dưới
bury your face in｜vùi mặt vào
tip: Phát âm giống berry; quá khứ buried, danh động từ burying.

senses.en: To put information on an official list
An official list or record of people or things

senses.zh: hiển thị; ghi lại số đo
senses.en: To show or record an amount on a measuring instrument

ex.en: You can register for swimming lessons at the pool.
Residents should be able to register for local healthcare services online, reducing unnecessary travel and administrative delays.

col: register for a course｜đăng ký khóa học
register to vote｜đăng ký đi bầu
register a complaint｜chính thức khiếu nại
tip: Đăng ký khóa học dùng register for; đăng ký làm việc gì dùng register to do.

senses.en: Join or fasten something to something else
Consider something to have a particular value or importance

ex.en: Attach the little bell to your bicycle's handlebars.
Many employers attach greater importance to practical experience than to academic qualifications when recruiting new staff.

col: attach something to something｜gắn cái gì vào cái gì
tip: Thường dùng attach A to B; tệp đính kèm trong email là attachment.

senses.zh: sự tôn trọng; sự kính trọng
senses.en: Admiration for someone or consideration for their rights and feelings.
To value someone or follow a rule or agreement.
A particular feature or aspect of something.

ex.en: She showed respect by listening without interrupting her colleague.
Schools should encourage students to respect different opinions while evaluating the evidence behind each argument.

col: show respect for｜thể hiện sự tôn trọng đối với
mutual respect｜sự tôn trọng lẫn nhau
respect privacy｜tôn trọng quyền riêng tư
tip: Danh từ thường đi với for; động từ đi thẳng với tân ngữ, không thêm for.

senses.en: The lowest supporting part or underlying foundation of something.
A place from which people work or organise activities.

senses.zh: dựa trên; lấy làm cơ sở
senses.en: To use something as the foundation for a decision or idea.

ex.en: The heavy base keeps the lamp from falling over.
Governments should base their environmental policies on reliable scientific evidence rather than short-term political interests.

col: base something on｜dựa điều gì trên
a research base｜căn cứ nghiên cứu
a solid base｜nền tảng vững chắc
tip: base A on B nghĩa là lấy B làm cơ sở để xây dựng A.

senses.en: to leave a place, especially to start a journey
to act differently from an established rule or practice

ex.en: Our train departs at dawn, so pack your bag tonight.
Buses that depart regularly from residential areas can reduce commuters' dependence on private cars.

col: depart from｜xuất phát từ; đi chệch khỏi
depart on time｜khởi hành đúng giờ
tip: depart from theo sau là nơi xuất phát; depart for theo sau là nơi đến.

senses.en: The process of taking one amount away from another.

ex.en: We practised subtraction by taking buttons out of a bowl.
A secure understanding of subtraction helps children develop the numerical skills needed for everyday financial decisions.

col: addition and subtraction｜phép cộng và phép trừ
tip: subtract A from B nghĩa là lấy B trừ A, chú ý thứ tự.

senses.zh: sự hiểu biết; sự thấu hiểu; sự thông cảm
senses.en: Knowledge of something, or sympathy for someone's feelings and situation.
Patient and sympathetic towards other people's feelings or difficulties.

senses.zh: thỏa thuận ngầm; sự đồng thuận
senses.en: An informal agreement between people or groups.

ex.en: Thanks for your understanding when I arrived late yesterday.
Learning another language can deepen students' understanding of different cultures and encourage greater respect for others.

col: a clear understanding of｜sự hiểu rõ về
reach an understanding｜đạt được sự đồng thuận
an understanding friend｜người bạn biết thông cảm
tip: “Sự hiểu biết về ...” dùng understanding of.

senses.en: a document showing that something has been paid for
the act of receiving something
money received by a business or organisation

ex.en: Keep your receipt in case the shoes don't fit.
Businesses should issue a receipt for every purchase to protect consumers and maintain accurate financial records.

col: on receipt of｜ngay khi nhận được
tip: Chữ p không đọc; khi nghĩa là khoản thu thường dùng số nhiều receipts.

senses.en: Something you can choose from a range of possibilities.

senses.zh: quyền lựa chọn; cơ hội chọn
senses.en: The right or opportunity to choose whether to do something.

ex.en: Taking the bus is our cheapest option today.
Remote working gives employees the option to live further from expensive city centres without changing jobs.

col: the best option｜lựa chọn tốt nhất
have no option but to｜không còn cách nào khác ngoài
keep your options open｜giữ các lựa chọn mở
the option to buy｜quyền chọn mua
tip: option là phương án có thể chọn; have no option but to theo sau là động từ nguyên mẫu.

senses.en: A path beside a road for people to walk on.
The hard surface covering a road or other outdoor area.

ex.en: We walked along the pavement beside the busy road.
Wider pavements can improve pedestrian safety and make urban neighbourhoods more accessible for wheelchair users.

col: walk on the pavement｜đi bộ trên vỉa hè
pavement café｜quán cà phê vỉa hè
tip: Trong tiếng Anh Anh là vỉa hè; trong tiếng Anh Mỹ thường chỉ mặt đường cứng.

senses.en: A marked face or rotating control on an instrument
Enter a telephone number to make a call

ex.en: Turn the dial clockwise to make the room warmer.
People who struggle with touchscreens may find a physical dial easier to use when adjusting household appliances.

col: a dial tone｜âm hiệu quay số
tip: Quá khứ trong tiếng Anh Anh thường là dialled, tiếng Anh Mỹ thường là dialed.

senses.en: extremely good or impressive

ex.en: We had a marvelous view of the snowy mountains.
Public libraries offer a marvelous opportunity for people of all ages to explore new interests.

col: a marvelous opportunity｜cơ hội tuyệt vời
a marvelous achievement｜thành tựu phi thường
a marvelous view｜khung cảnh tuyệt đẹp
tip: marvelous là cách viết của Anh Mỹ; Anh Anh thường viết marvellous.

senses.en: Something that must be done, possessed, or provided
Something needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: Wearing a helmet is a requirement at this skatepark.
Clear entry requirements help prospective students assess whether they are adequately prepared for university courses.

col: meet the requirements｜đáp ứng yêu cầu
a legal requirement｜yêu cầu theo luật định
tip: Đáp ứng yêu cầu dùng meet requirements, không dùng reach.

senses.en: one of the Earth's main large areas of land

ex.en: Our teacher pointed to the African continent on a globe.
Climate change affects every continent, although its consequences vary considerably between regions and communities.

col: the African continent｜lục địa châu Phi
tip: continent là châu lục, country là quốc gia.

senses.zh: có đủ khả năng chi trả
senses.en: to have enough money or resources for something
to provide something useful or desirable

ex.en: We cannot afford a new sofa this month.
Without financial assistance, many students cannot afford to attend university despite having strong academic potential.

col: can afford to do｜có đủ khả năng làm việc gì
cannot afford to lose｜không thể để mất
afford protection｜cung cấp sự bảo vệ
tip: Thường dùng can afford sth hoặc can afford to do, không đi với doing.

senses.en: a thing that can be seen or touched
to express disagreement with something
the aim of an action or activity

ex.en: A shiny object was lying beneath the sofa.
Many residents object to the proposed airport expansion because it could increase noise pollution.

col: object to a proposal｜phản đối một đề xuất
the object of the exercise｜mục đích của hoạt động
tip: Danh từ nhấn âm đầu, động từ nhấn âm sau; object to theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ.

senses.en: Feeling as if you or your surroundings are spinning.

ex.en: I felt dizzy after spinning around with my little cousin.
People who feel dizzy during exercise should stop immediately and seek medical advice if symptoms persist.

col: a dizzy spell｜một cơn choáng váng
make someone dizzy｜làm ai chóng mặt
tip: Người làm chủ ngữ dùng feel dizzy; sự vật có thể make someone dizzy.

senses.zh: gian lận; hành vi lừa dối
senses.en: Dishonest behaviour intended to gain an unfair advantage.

ex.en: Peeking at another player's cards is cheating, even among friends.
Schools can discourage cheating by designing assessments that reward independent thinking rather than the simple recall of facts.

col: cheating in exams｜gian lận trong thi cử
accuse someone of cheating｜buộc tội ai gian lận
tip: Khi chỉ hành vi thì thường không đếm được; cheat cũng có thể chỉ kẻ gian lận.

senses.en: Mental strain caused by difficult situations or too many demands
To give particular importance to something when speaking or writing
Extra force used when pronouncing a syllable or word

ex.en: A short walk helps me deal with work stress.
Schools should teach students practical strategies for managing stress during examinations and other demanding periods.

col: stress the importance of｜nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng của
tip: Người cảm thấy căng thẳng dùng stressed; việc gây căng thẳng dùng stressful.

senses.en: Not present where someone is expected to be.
Not existing or found in a particular place or situation.

ex.en: Lina was absent from class because she felt ill.
Students who are frequently absent from school may require additional support to keep up with their classmates.

tip: Vắng mặt ở đâu dùng absent from, không dùng absent in.

senses.en: a person who writes poems

ex.en: The poet read her latest work beside the fireplace.
A poet can challenge social attitudes by expressing familiar experiences in unexpected and emotionally powerful ways.

col: a celebrated poet｜một nhà thơ nổi tiếng
a contemporary poet｜một nhà thơ đương đại
a poet's work｜tác phẩm của nhà thơ
tip: poet là nhà thơ, poem là một bài thơ, poetry là thơ nói chung.

senses.en: Completely necessary for a particular purpose or situation
Relating to the most important characteristics of something

senses.zh: nhu yếu phẩm; điều cốt yếu
senses.en: A necessary item or basic fact, usually mentioned in plural

ex.en: A warm coat is essential for this winter walk.
Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.

col: essential for survival｜thiết yếu cho sự sống
daily essentials｜nhu yếu phẩm hằng ngày
tip: Danh từ thường dùng số nhiều essentials, nghĩa là nhu yếu phẩm hoặc điểm cốt yếu.

senses.en: A very large sea mammal that breathes air.

ex.en: A whale surfaced beside our boat and sprayed water.
Protecting whale populations requires international cooperation because these marine mammals migrate across vast areas of ocean.

tip: Cá voi là động vật có vú, không phải cá; số nhiều thường là whales.

senses.en: The study of how societies produce, distribute, and use resources.

senses.zh: yếu tố kinh tế; tính khả thi về kinh tế
senses.en: The financial factors affecting whether an activity is practical.

ex.en: My sister studies economics and enjoys discussing food prices.
Studying economics helps students understand how government policies influence employment, inflation, and the distribution of wealth.

col: behavioural economics｜kinh tế học hành vi
the economics of recycling｜tính khả thi kinh tế của việc tái chế
tip: Khi chỉ môn học, dù tận cùng bằng s vẫn đi với động từ số ít.

senses.en: a small area of still water surrounded by land

ex.en: A green frog jumped into the pond beside our house.
Creating ponds in urban parks can provide valuable habitats for amphibians and increase local biodiversity.

col: pond life｜sinh vật sống trong ao
tip: pond thường nhỏ hơn lake; có thể là ao tự nhiên hoặc nhân tạo.

senses.en: very pleased about something

ex.en: Lina was delighted to find her missing bracelet.
Residents were delighted with the new library, which offered free internet access and a welcoming space for study.

col: delighted with the result｜rất hài lòng với kết quả
tip: Người cảm thấy vui dùng delighted; sự vật gây thích thú dùng delightful.

senses.en: A device that captures sound for recording or making it louder.

ex.en: Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear.
Using a microphone during lectures can help students hear clearly, particularly in large classrooms with poor acoustics.

col: speak into a microphone｜nói vào micrô
tip: microphone thu âm; speaker phát âm thanh, đừng nhầm.

senses.en: a musical instrument played by hitting its stretched surface
a large cylindrical container for storing liquids or other materials
to play a drum or tap something repeatedly

ex.en: The little boy beat the drum with both hands.
Learning to play the drum can help children develop coordination and participate in group performances.

tip: play the drums thường chỉ chơi trống; drum cũng có thể chỉ thùng phuy.

senses.en: A performer who entertains people by doing seemingly impossible tricks.
A person believed or imagined to have magical powers.

ex.en: The magician pulled a silk scarf from an empty cup.
A skilled magician can demonstrate how easily human attention is directed away from important visual details.

col: performing magician｜ảo thuật gia biểu diễn
stage magician｜ảo thuật gia sân khấu
skilled magician｜ảo thuật gia lành nghề
tip: Ngoài đời chỉ người biểu diễn ảo thuật; trong truyện cũng có thể chỉ pháp sư.

senses.en: Relating to skilled work or an activity done for payment.
Showing the skill and behaviour expected of a trained worker.

senses.zh: người làm nghề chuyên nghiệp; vận động viên chuyên nghiệp
senses.en: Someone trained for skilled work or paid to perform.

ex.en: We hired a professional photographer for our wedding.
Continuous professional development helps teachers adapt their methods to changing student needs and new educational technologies.

col: professional athlete｜vận động viên chuyên nghiệp
healthcare professional｜nhân viên y tế chuyên nghiệp
tip: Đối lập với amateur thì nhấn mạnh tính chuyên nghiệp; khi nói về thái độ thì nhấn mạnh sự chuyên nghiệp, đúng mực.

senses.en: To mix something by moving a spoon or similar object around.
To cause a strong feeling or reaction.

senses.zh: sự xôn xao; sự náo động
senses.en: Excitement or surprise caused by an event or action.

ex.en: Stir the soup gently so it does not stick.
Documentaries about endangered animals can stir public concern and encourage stronger support for wildlife conservation.

col: stir in｜vừa khuấy vừa cho vào
tip: Quá khứ stirred và hiện tại phân từ stirring đều gấp đôi chữ r.

senses.en: very important, large, or serious

senses.zh: chuyên ngành chính; sinh viên chuyên ngành
senses.en: a main university subject, or a student studying that subject
to study a particular subject as your main university subject

ex.en: The storm caused major damage to our roof.
Access to affordable childcare remains a major concern for parents who wish to return to work.

col: major in biology｜học chuyên ngành sinh học
tip: Động từ “học chuyên ngành” dùng major in; chủ yếu dùng trong tiếng Anh Mỹ.

senses.en: mathematics involving addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division

ex.en: We practised mental arithmetic while waiting for the bus.
Strong arithmetic skills help young adults manage personal budgets and make informed financial decisions.

tip: Là danh từ thường không đếm được; phạm vi hẹp hơn mathematics.

senses.en: Fire a gun or another weapon; hit with a bullet
Take photographs or record a film
A new part growing from a plant

ex.en: She learned to shoot arrows at a local club.
Film crews often shoot documentaries in remote locations to highlight the effects of climate change.

tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là shot; shoot at nghĩa là bắn vào.

senses.en: A plump bird with short legs, commonly seen in cities

ex.en: A grey pigeon landed on the bench beside me.
Urban pigeon populations often grow where food waste is abundant, highlighting the importance of effective rubbish collection.

col: a flock of pigeons｜một đàn bồ câu
feed the pigeons｜cho bồ câu ăn
tip: Chú ý chính tả pigeon; từ đồng âm pidgin chỉ ngôn ngữ pha trộn.

senses.en: the production of goods in factories
businesses that provide a particular type of product or service

senses.zh: sự cần cù; sự siêng năng
senses.en: steady effort and hard work

ex.en: The fishing industry provides jobs for many local families.
Investment in cleaner technology could help heavy industry reduce emissions without significantly lowering production levels.

col: industrial development｜sự phát triển công nghiệp
tip: Thuộc công nghiệp dùng industrial; chăm chỉ dùng industrious.

senses.en: A situation that makes it possible to do something.

ex.en: The school trip gave me an opportunity to try climbing.
Public libraries provide an important opportunity for residents to develop skills without paying expensive course fees.

col: an opportunity to learn｜cơ hội học tập
seize an opportunity｜nắm bắt cơ hội
tip: Thường dùng an opportunity to do, nghĩa là cơ hội để làm gì.

senses.en: Knives, forks, and spoons used for eating or serving food.

ex.en: Please put the clean cutlery beside the plates.
Restaurants can reduce plastic waste by replacing disposable cutlery with durable alternatives that can be washed and reused.

col: a set of cutlery｜một bộ dao dĩa
disposable cutlery｜dao dĩa dùng một lần
stainless steel cutlery｜dao dĩa bằng thép không gỉ
tip: Danh từ không đếm được; một món dụng cụ ăn dùng a piece of cutlery.

senses.en: used to add another negative statement or alternative

ex.en: I could neither find my keys nor remember where I parked.
Expanding roads alone will neither solve traffic congestion nor reduce the environmental damage caused by private vehicles.

col: nor can we｜chúng tôi cũng không thể
tip: nor khi nối các mệnh đề độc lập thường đảo ngữ: nor do I.

senses.zh: sự liên lạc; sự tiếp xúc
senses.en: Communication with someone, or physical touching between things.
To communicate with someone by calling, writing, or another method.
Someone you know who can offer help or information.

ex.en: Please contact the receptionist if you lose your key.
Regular contact with family members can reduce loneliness among older people who live alone.

col: keep in contact with｜giữ liên lạc với
tip: Động từ contact đi thẳng với người, không thêm with; danh từ có thể thêm with.

senses.en: Made from wool.

ex.en: I pulled on thick woollen socks before going outside.
Although woollen clothing provides excellent insulation, its environmental impact depends partly on farming practices and manufacturing methods.

col: a woollen jumper｜áo len chui đầu
tip: Anh Anh viết woollen; Anh Mỹ thường viết woolen.

senses.zh: ngăn ngừa; ngăn chặn; cản trở
senses.en: To stop something happening or someone doing something.

ex.en: This tight lid will prevent the soup from spilling.
Investing in early health education can help prevent chronic diseases and reduce future pressure on public healthcare services.

col: prevent someone from doing｜ngăn ai làm việc gì
tip: Dùng prevent sb from doing, không dùng prevent sb to do.

senses.en: very angry
behaving or thinking in an unreasonable or foolish way
extremely enthusiastic about someone or something

ex.en: Dad was mad because I broke his favourite cup.
Although some residents are mad about football, public sports funding should support a wider range of activities.

col: drive someone mad｜làm ai phát điên
tip: mad at nghĩa là giận; mad about có thể nghĩa là mê mẩn.

senses.en: A place where people are kept as punishment or awaiting trial.
Put someone in jail.

ex.en: The old jail now welcomes visitors as a museum.
Education programmes in jail can help prisoners develop skills and improve their chances of finding work after release.

col: be jailed for fraud｜bị bỏ tù vì tội lừa đảo
tip: in jail nghĩa là đang bị giam, không dùng mạo từ; cách viết cũ trong tiếng Anh Anh là gaol.

senses.en: something that makes success harder or reduces something's value

ex.en: The main disadvantage of this flat is the noise.
Students without reliable internet access face a significant disadvantage when schools rely heavily on online learning.

col: at a disadvantage｜ở thế bất lợi
a major disadvantage｜một nhược điểm lớn
advantages and disadvantages｜ưu điểm và nhược điểm
tip: Ở thế bất lợi dùng at a disadvantage.

senses.en: easy to recognise because you have encountered it before
having knowledge or experience of something

ex.en: I heard a familiar voice outside the kitchen door.
Students who are familiar with digital tools may adapt more easily to online learning environments.

col: a familiar face｜một gương mặt quen thuộc
tip: Người quen với sự vật dùng with; sự vật quen thuộc với người dùng to.

senses.en: Extremely good and very enjoyable.
Causing great surprise or admiration.

ex.en: We had a marvellous picnic beside the lake.
Public gardens offer marvellous opportunities for urban residents to relax and reconnect with nature.

col: a marvellous idea｜một ý tưởng tuyệt vời
a marvellous opportunity｜một cơ hội tuyệt vời
a marvellous achievement｜một thành tựu đáng nể
tip: Anh Anh viết marvellous, Anh Mỹ thường viết marvelous.

senses.en: Force air suddenly from your throat with a rough sound.
The act or sound of coughing, or an illness causing it.

ex.en: The dusty room made me cough several times.
People with a persistent cough should seek medical advice, particularly if symptoms interfere with sleep or daily activities.

tip: gh ở đây đọc là /f/; have a cough nghĩa là bị ho.

senses.en: An object with strings used to hit balls in sports.
A loud, unpleasant noise.

ex.en: I left my tennis racket beside the court.
Providing basic equipment, such as a racket, can make school sports more accessible to children.

tip: Vợt cũng có thể viết là racquet; còn nghĩa tiếng ồn ào chỉ dùng racket.

senses.en: In a similar way; also true of another person or thing

ex.en: The twins dress similarly but have very different personalities.
Public libraries provide free access to information; similarly, community centres offer valuable opportunities for lifelong learning.

col: similarly affected｜chịu ảnh hưởng tương tự
tip: Similarly đầu câu thường theo sau là dấu phẩy, dùng để nêu một trường hợp tương tự.

senses.en: A handled container used for holding and pouring liquids.
The amount of liquid a jug holds.

ex.en: Please bring a jug of water to the table.
Serving tap water in a reusable jug can help restaurants reduce their reliance on disposable plastic bottles.

col: a jug of water｜một bình nước
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh thường chỉ bình miệng rộng có vòi; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường chỉ bình cổ hẹp có quai.

senses.zh: hợp thời trang; đang thịnh hành
senses.en: Popular or considered attractive at a particular time.

ex.en: Those colourful trainers are fashionable among my friends.
Consumers often replace fashionable clothing quickly, increasing textile waste and placing pressure on natural resources.

col: fashionable clothes｜quần áo hợp thời trang
a fashionable district｜khu phố sành điệu
tip: Không chỉ tả quần áo mà còn có thể tả quan niệm, hoạt động hoặc khu vực.

senses.en: a thin, crisp biscuit, often eaten with cheese

ex.en: I packed some crackers and cheese for the picnic.
Although crackers are convenient snacks, some varieties contain substantial amounts of salt and should be eaten in moderation.

col: cheese and crackers｜phô mai ăn kèm bánh quy giòn
wholegrain crackers｜bánh quy giòn ngũ cốc nguyên hạt
tip: Thường chỉ loại bánh quy mỏng, giòn và mặn, không nhất thiết là bánh quy soda.
